attributes.board_name: Kansas State Board of Healing Arts

rules.accepted_credit_types: Content related to OT or similar areas. At least 30 hours from Class I (lectures, panels, workshops, seminars, symposia, college courses at 10 h per credit hour; home study/internet courses with evaluation max 20), Class IV (publications: book/original paper 30, review/case report/abstract 15), Class V (preparing Class I presentations, 3 h per hour presented, max 30) or Class VI (Level II fieldwork supervision, 1 h per full-time week, max 24). Class II in-service max 8; Class III professional reading max 2. 1 contact hour = 60 minutes.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed within 1 year of the CE reporting renewal: no CE for that first period; licensed or reinstated 1–2 years before: 20 contact hours.
rules.audit_note: Evidence of CE is submitted before or with the renewal application in odd-numbered years (documented attendance for Class I/II, copies of publications, employer verification for fieldwork). The Board partners with CE Broker for tracking. Extensions up to 6 months for good cause.
rules.notes: Licenses renew annually and expire March 31 each year (renewal window Feb 15 – March 31, late renewal April 1–30), but CE evidence is due only at the renewal in odd-numbered years, covering the preceding 24 months. Professional liability insurance is also required.
rules.rule_quote: (a)(1) Each licensee shall submit evidence of completing at least 40 contact hours of continuing education during the preceding 24 months.
